titleEn: Download all my data, or close my account

undo.note: the export only reads; closing an account is irreversible

en: Can I download all my store data?
How do I close my account?

steps: Open Settings, press Download my data
You get a zip: one NDJSON file per table plus manifest.json
edgeCases: One export per store per hour (429 after that)
Above 20000 rows in total the export is refused with 413 EXPORT_TOO_LARGE and a plain message (an async job for bigger stores is not built)
Owner only; another store answers 404; the bundle holds only that store's rows and no API key hashes or provider credentials
Closing the account is refused while the owner has a live billed store or money in flight; the erasure job is flag-gated (PDPL_CF_ERASURE_ENABLED), flag off records the request
gaps: Account closure from the admin app is not built (it lives in the web account settings only)
